answer_1.quote: We evaluate our methods on three standard translation benchmark datasets: IWSLT'14 De-En (De-En), WMT'14 En-De (En-De), and WMT'16 En-Ro (En-Ro).
answer_1.outputs: translated text outputs in neural machine translation

answer_2.quote: Achieving similar performance on three tasks, Hypoformer can compress Transformer base model 2.9 ∼ 4.5×, and speedup it 1.9 ∼ 3.3× on Intel CPU and 1.8 ∼ 3.9× on Raspberry Pi ARM CPU. Notably, when the parameter scale is extremely low, Hypoformer achieves a 7.1 higher BLEU score and 1.27× speedup than Transformer on IWSLT'14 De-En task.
